steps.prompt: The rim reaches our RW on the right wall. Their LD leaves the point and comes down the wall. What are they doing?

options.text: Coming to trap the puck on our wall
options.fb: Right. That is a pinch. Their LD wants to stop the puck before our blue line, and their LW comes down the wall too.

options.text: Covering our C in the middle lane
options.fb: Someone does cover the middle, but it is their RW. Their LD comes for the puck itself, down the wall to our RW.

options.text: Chasing our RD behind our net
options.fb: That is their C, the forecheck. Their LD stays on the wall where the puck is going, and comes down to meet it.

options.text: Going back to cover their own net
options.fb: They are skating toward our net, not theirs. A defender who leaves the point wants the puck stopped in our zone.

steps.prompt: Their LD comes down late, and our RW already has the puck. What does getting past them give us?

options.text: Three of us against their two defenders
options.fb: Right. Their forwards are behind the play. Our RW, our C and our LW go up the ice with speed against two: a 3-on-2, and a rush.

options.text: A pass across to our LW
options.fb: Possible later, but that pass goes past their RW in the middle. Carry it first. Past their LD, three of us attack their two defenders.

options.text: Nothing, their C catches our RW
options.fb: Their C is behind now, still chasing. Once our RW is past their LD, only their two defenders are in front of three of us.

steps.prompt: Their RW stays in the middle. Tap the middle lane where it crosses our blue line.

fb.right: Right. The middle of the ice at our blue line. Their RW stays near it, so a pass there has to get past them.
fb.close: Near, but off to one side. The middle lane runs up the center of the ice, halfway between the walls.
fb.wrong: The middle lane is the center of the ice on the way out. Look at our blue line, halfway between the two walls.
